name: Jellyfin-Tuned
description: Radio, Surf TV, a simpler Music page and a tidier layout for the Jellyfin web UI.
overview: Live radio, Jamendo, free TV and antenna channels, an Apple Music style Music page, TV and Movies sections with tabs, a Request link to Seerr, rotating home rows, seasonal tiles.

versions.changelog: Embedded Request page fills the window exactly and no longer scrolls the page behind it
Player controls stay up while hovered, radio stops Jellyfin's player, Jamendo card fix, Request inside Jellyfin on the same site, Now Playing shuffle/repeat/lyrics
Surf shares busy antenna tuners: skips channels that can't start, marks them, names the ones you can join; unique stream tickets
Now named Jellyfin-Tuned. Settings split into tabs (Radio & TV, Layout, Home), new Request link to Seerr or Jellyseerr
Music page (Search, Catalog, Now Playing, Radio), TV and Movies sections with tabs, home TV row, fixes for Jellyfin Media Player
First public release: radio, Jamendo, Surf TV, rotating home rows, seasonal tiles
